project_title: SMART HEALTH & SUPPLY CHAIN RESILIENCE — Federated AI Platform for National Health Resource Intelligence
design_context: National Government Healthcare Command Centre / Public Infrastructure Intelligence
target_audience: Government Officials, State/District Health Magistrates, PHC Medical Officers, Healthcare Logistics Directors, Academic Evaluators & Panellists

theme.primary_philosophy: Tactical Enterprise Clarity. High-density, data-driven, solid surface visual architecture with high contrast and zero unnecessary visual clutter.

page_title.class: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
page_title.description: Used for main page module headers and primary command title

section_heading.class: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
section_heading.description: Used for card headers, section titles, and map panel overlays

sub_heading.description: Used for widget sub-titles, table column groupings, and metric descriptors

kpi_value.class: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50 font-mono
kpi_value.description: Large numerical readout on KPI metric cards

body.description: Standard body text for descriptions, tables, tooltips, and log entries

caption.description: Used for metadata, last-synced timestamps, and secondary info

overline_label.class: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
overline_label.description: Eyebrow labels for category tags, status section headers, and data sources

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: High Density Command Grid
layout_and_spacing.shadow_style: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

center: State/District Selector Dropdown (e.g. National View -> Maharashtra -> Pune)
right: User Role Switcher (National Health Director, State Nodal Officer, District Magistrate, PHC Doctor)

features: Value readout in bold font-mono
Percentage change badge (up/down chevron)
Sparkline line/bar chart widget
Status dot indicator (Green/Amber/Red)
Click to filter or drill down
Interactive state and district polygon highlights or geo-markers
Color-coded risk circles (Green: Optimal, Amber: At-Risk, Red: Critical Stockout)
Click marker to open PHC / District Inspector drawer
Filter map by metric: Stockout Risk, Bed Occupancy, Personnel Deficit, Outbreak Warning
Zoom controls, fullscreen toggle, state boundary overlay

supply_chain_flow.visual: Interactive movement visualizer with route status cards, transit ETA, cold-chain temperature logs, stock transfer table, and Recharts flow indicators

features: Historical vs AI Predicted Consumption line
Shaded Confidence Interval Band (95% CI)
Epidemic surge risk projections toggle
Medicine category dropdown filter (Essential Antibiotics, Maternal Care, Vaccines, ICU Consumables)
Severity tag (Critical, High Risk, Moderate)
Risk Score percentage gauge (0-100%)
Root cause summary generated by Federated AI node
One-click 'Trigger Inter-District Transfer' or 'Escalate to State' action button
Source PHC (Surplus) -> Target PHC (Deficit) visual transfer card
Quantity calculator & estimated travel time
Approve Transfer modal with DPI digital signature simulation
Reject / Modify reallocation proposal
Network graph or grid of 36 State & Union Territory nodes
Privacy-Preserving Training status (Local model epoch, Differential Privacy epsilon metric)
Model convergence chart and bandwidth efficiency metrics
Advanced filterable table (by State, District, Facility Type: PHC/CHC/DH, Stock Status)
Search by PHC Name or Unique Health Facility ID (NIN)
Detail drawer / page with live staff attendance, bed count, generator fuel, oxygen cylinder status

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid clean panels (`bg-white` or `bg-slate-900`) with precise 1px borders (`border-slate-200` or `border-slate-800`). No heavy dark gradients.
visual_enhancers.status_badges: Pill style badges with live pulse dot indicator (`before:animate-ping`) for active emergencies
visual_enhancers.charts: Custom Recharts tooltip with crisp shadow, formatted numbers, and contrasting grid lines (`strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='#E2E8F0'`)
visual_enhancers.toasts: Sonner toasts for actions (Transfer requested, Emergency mode activated, Report generated, Role switched)
visual_enhancers.skeletons: Tailwind `animate-pulse` rectangular skeletons for seamless simulated data fetching states

testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text against light gray or deep navy background
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring indicator (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 12 left navigation items switch views or sub-views cleanly without blank screens.

Include synthetic realistic Indian healthcare data (e.g., states like Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Kerala, Assam; medicines like Amoxicillin, Paracetamol, ORS, Snake Antivenom, Insulin; PHC IDs like PHC-MH-PUN-042).
Ensure Emergency Surge Mode transforms the UI with a glowing top alert banner and prioritizes critical red alerts.
All buttons, inputs, tables, tabs, switches, and modals MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
Use Lucide-react icons exclusively for all status indicators, navigation links, and action buttons.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating headers. Use `bg-white dark:bg-slate-900` with explicit borders.
